summary.en: Maxwell's relations are four equalities between partial derivatives of pressure, volume, temperature and entropy, derived from the fact that each thermodynamic potential's mixed second partial derivatives must agree — they let a hard-to-measure quantity such as (∂S/∂V)_T be replaced by an easily measured one such as (∂p/∂T)_V.
summary.et: Maxwelli seosed on neli võrdust rõhu, ruumala, temperatuuri ja entroopia osatuletiste vahel; need tulenevad sellest, et igal termodünaamilisel potentsiaalil peavad segatud teist järku osatuletised ühtima — nii saab raskesti mõõdetava suuruse, näiteks (∂S/∂V)_T, asendada kergesti mõõdetavaga, näiteks (∂p/∂T)_V.
